page_title: CEL 1-2 RMA | Celta Vigo v Real Madrid 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well over the crossbar.
90+2' Golden chance! Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
90+1' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) makes a strong challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
88' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes.
87' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) replaces Fran Beltran.
86' The total number of attempts is 11:10.
83' Real Madrid are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
82' What was Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
82' Today's match ends for Kylian Mbappe who will be replaced by Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid).

80' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Celta Vigo are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
78' Here is a change. Jonathan Bamba is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo).
78' The manager makes a subsitution with Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) coming on for Borja Iglesias.
77' Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Thibaut Courtois easily deals with the threat.
75' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
75' The attendance for today's match is 24445.
74' Celta Vigo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
74' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The linesman points to the corner flag, Celta Vigo are going to take it.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) replaces Williot Swedberg.
72' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Javier Manquillo is replaced by Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
71' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) lashes the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
70' A substitution has been made. Fran Garcia is replaced by Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid).
69' Lovely run from Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
68' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
66' 1 - 2 Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is released by Luka Modric, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
65' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
64' Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
64' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luka Modric (Real Madrid) replacing Federico Valverde.
63' Substitution. Eduardo Camavinga makes his way off the pitch and Rodrygo (Real Madrid) comes on as his replacement.
63' Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
61' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but Vicente Guaita punches the ball away.
59' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
57' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
56' The free kick is delivered by Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.

55' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. It's a free kick to Celta Vigo, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
54' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.

52' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Oscar Mingueza. The score is now 1:1.
50' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
48' Celta Vigo are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
47' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul.
46' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the left post.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Celta Vigo players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.

43' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Real Madrid are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

41' A fine solo run by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
41' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
40' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.

39' Chance! Federico Valverde sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker over the bar.
38' Alejandro Hernandez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo).
37' The resulting corner from Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) comes to nothing.
36' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Real Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.

35' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
33' Celta Vigo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
31' A quickly taken corner by Celta Vigo.
31' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Celta Vigo will take a corner kick.
31' Real Madrid exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.
28' Wonderful movement by Real Madrid. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
27' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
26' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Celta Vigo.
24' Real Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
22' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) has a goal ruled out for offside!

20' 0 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a magnificent shot into the top left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Vicente Guaita, so the score changes to 0:1.
19' Carlo Ancelotti appears to have said too much and referee Alejandro Hernandez comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
18' Real Madrid are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
17' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
15' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

15' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Real Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
13' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
12' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
10' The Real Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

9' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) releases a powerful first-time effort from the edge of the box which goes in the direction of the middle of the target, but the keeper reacts quickly enough to deny him. Excellent goalkeeping!
9' Celta Vigo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

8' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Thibaut Courtois to get hold of the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Celta Vigo.
7' Real Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
5' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) brings his opponent down. Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
4' Neat passing move from Real Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Great teamplay by Celta Vigo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Real Madrid will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Hernandez will referee today's match.
